title: Kuaishou's Kling AI rumored to list in Hong Kong: not yet profitable, valued above 100 billion yuan, investors set buyback terms
source_used: Sina Finance (10 Oct 2026, quoting Phoenix WEEKLY Finance interviews); OFweek (mp.ofweek.com, 10 Oct 2026) for cross-check.
key_facts: Foreign media (Bloomberg, 6 Oct 2026) reported Kling AI plans to start a Hong Kong listing process within 12 months, possibly filing in early 2027, to raise at least $1 billion.

Kuaishou's July 2026 financing announcement set Kling's outside funding at up to about $3 billion, at a pre-money valuation of about $15 billion and a maximum post-money valuation of $18 billion (over 120 billion yuan).
Kling launched in June 2024 and earns money from user subscriptions and business API (software connection) access.
Kling's revenue passed 1.5 billion yuan in the first half of 2026 (above 650 million yuan in Q1 and above 850 million in Q2), against about 1.1 billion yuan in all of 2025.
Kling is still loss-making: unnamed market sources say cumulative losses over 2025 and Q1 2026 exceeded 2 billion yuan, and other media say a quarterly break-even is not expected until Q4 2028.
Kling's annualised revenue was close to $500 million in March; the $18 billion valuation is about 36 times that.

Under the July terms, if Beijing Kling has not completed an IPO by the agreed deadline or 30 Oct 2031, whichever is earlier, investors can require it to buy back their equity at the original price plus 8 percent simple yearly interest, less dividends received.
Analyst Zhang Yi of iiMedia says the buyback term is more a bargaining chip than an immediate pressure.
quote_evidence: 近日，有外媒报道称，可灵AI计划在未来12个月内启动香港上市程序，最早或于2027年初向港交所递交上市申请，拟融资至少10亿美元。
回购金额包括原始投资价款，加上按单利年利率8%计算的回报，并扣除已收到的股息和分派。
与千亿元估值形成反差的，是可灵AI经营仍在亏损。
why_it_matters_hint: A loss-making AI video business that outside investors valued at up to $18 billion may list in Hong Kong, with buyback terms if it does not list by 30 Oct 2031.
event_date: 6 Oct 2026 (Bloomberg listing report); 2 Jul 2026 (Kuaishou financing announcement)
notes: FOLLOW-UP of our 6 Oct 2026 edition (Bloomberg: Kling picked banks for a Hong Kong listing of at least $1 billion). The Sina article is a Chinese-language analysis that restates that report and Kuaishou's July filings; the loss figures come from unnamed market sources. The pool headline says valued above 100 billion yuan; the July announcement gives a maximum of about $18 billion, over 120 billion yuan. Read in Chinese.
